title: 50 Cent Army
excerpt: Chinese officials posting pro-government comments disguised as ordinary opinion; leaked 2014 emails let researchers estimate 448 million fabricated posts a year.
excerptEs: Funcionarios chinos que publican comentarios progubernamentales disfrazados de opinión corriente; correos filtrados en 2014 permitieron estimar 448 millones de mensajes al año.

sources.title: King, Pan and Roberts, How the Chinese Government Fabricates Social Media Posts for Strategic Distraction, Not Engaged Argument, American Political Science Review 111(3), 2017
Leaks Reveal China's Elaborate Internet Propaganda Machine (China Digital Times, December 2014)
Inside China's Elaborate and Absurd Internet Propaganda Machine (Quartz, republished by Nextgov, December 2014)
Leaked Documents Show How China's Army of Paid Internet Trolls Helped Censor the Coronavirus (The New York Times and ProPublica, December 2020)
